definitions.explanation: Matters related to hiring, firing, transfers, and management of employees.
Something that concerns others, not oneself (often in {他人事|ひとごと}).

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}{部|ぶ}に{連絡|れんらく}してください。
{来月|らいげつ}、{大|おお}きな{人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}がある。
examples.english: There will be major personnel changes next month.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}を{尽|つ}くして{天命|てんめい}を{待|ま}つ。
examples.english: Do your best and leave the rest to fate. (proverb)

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}{課|か}で{働|はたら}いている。
examples.english: I work in the personnel department.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}{評価|ひょうか}の{時期|じき}だ。
{人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう}で{転勤|てんきん}になった。
examples.english: I was transferred due to a personnel change.

examples.japanese: {人事|じんじ}{担当者|たんとうしゃ}に{相談|そうだん}した。
examples.english: I consulted with the HR person.

examples.japanese: {他人事|ひとごと}のように{言|い}う。
examples.english: To speak as if it were someone else's problem.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{他人事|ひとごと}だと{思|おも}っている。
examples.english: He thinks it doesn't concern him.

notes:
{人事|じんじ} primarily refers to personnel management or HR matters in a business context.

Common collocations:
- {人事|じんじ}{部|ぶ} (HR department, personnel department)
- {人事|じんじ}{異動|いどう} (personnel transfer, job reassignment)
- {人事|じんじ}{評価|ひょうか} (personnel evaluation)
- {人事|じんじ}{担当|たんとう} (HR person in charge)

Proverb:
- {人事|じんじ}を{尽|つ}くして{天命|てんめい}を{待|ま}つ (Do your best and leave the rest to heaven/fate)

Note: {他人事|ひとごと/たにんごと} (other people's business, not one's concern) uses different readings.
